mapper.select: SELECT A.STAGE_OF_ASSET || '_' || A.ABSOLUTE_OF_ELEMENTS ||'_'||A.ELEMENTS AS item, A.ELEMENTS_VALUE AS itemValue FROM MOD_STAGE_PARA A WHERE 1=1 AND A.STATUS = '01'
SELECT A.MDATE AS planEndDate, A.PS AS dealSide FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL A WHERE FINPROD_ID = #{assetId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND IS_CLEAN = 'Y' AND PS IN('T23','T22')

SELECT A.FINPROD_ID FINPROD_ID, A.CASH_ID CASH_ID, B.CASH_TYPE_2 CASH_TYPE_2, A.VDATE_UNADJUST VDATE_UNADJUST, A.MDATE_UNADJUST MDATE_UNADJUST, A.VDATE VDATE, A.MDATE MDATE, A.PAY_DATE PAY_DATE, A.PRIN_AMT PRIN_AMT, A.INT_AMT INT_AMT, A.CASH_AMT CASH_AMT, A.INT_PRIN_AMT INT_PRIN_AMT FROM FIN_CASH_PLAN A INNER JOIN FIN_CASH_INFO B ON A.CASH_ID = B.CASH_ID AND B.CASH_TYPE_2 = 'C02' WHERE A.FINPROD_ID= #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ORDER BY A.MDATE
